display_long_description:
Step into a new dimension of rhythm.

BeatGesture is a VR rhythm game where your hands are the controller. Match hand gestures, positions, and timing to the beat for a fully immersive experience.

Designed for Meta Quest hand tracking with stylized, rhythm-driven environments.

[media]

[Gesture-Based Gameplay] 

Hit incoming notes by matching the correct hand shape, placing your hand in the right position, and timing it perfectly with the music. Simple to learn, deeply satisfying to master.

[Expressive Controls]

Play using natural gestures like fists, open hands, thumbs up, and L-shapes. Direction-based variations and two-hand patterns add depth and challenge.

[Dynamic Note Types]

Tap – Hit on beat

Hold – Maintain your gesture

Swipe – Hit the note in the arrow direction


[Game Modes]

Campaign – Progress through increasingly challenging stages

Free Play – Replay songs with selectable difficulty

Passthrough support available.

Feel the beat.

Your hands are the instrument.
